python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate annual average CPI-U
cpi_1960 = [29.370, 29.410, 29.410, 29.540, 29.570, 29.610, 29.550, 29.610, 29.610, 29.750, 29.780, 29.810]
cpi_1961 = [29.840, 29.840, 29.840, 29.810, 29.840, 29.840, 29.920, 29.940, 29.980, 29.980, 29.980, 30.010]
cpi_1962 = [30.040, 30.110, 30.170, 30.210, 30.240, 30.210, 30.220, 30.280, 30.420, 30.380, 30.380, 30.380]

avg_cpi_1960 = sum(cpi_1960) / 12
avg_cpi_1961 = sum(cpi_1961) / 12
avg_cpi_1962 = sum(cpi_1962) / 12

print(f"Average CPI 1960: {avg_cpi_1960}")
print(f"Average CPI 1961: {avg_cpi_1961}")
print(f"Average CPI 1962: {avg_cpi_1962}")

# Nominal debt values from Treasury Bulletin (public debt outstanding)
# Using "The public" column - Total
debt_1960 = 237177  # millions
debt_1961 = 238604  # millions
debt_1962 = 248373  # millions

# Adjust to constant 1962 dollars
# Formula: Adjusted = Nominal * (CPI_1962 / CPI_original)
adj_1960 = debt_1960 * (avg_cpi_1962 / avg_cpi_1960)
adj_1961 = debt_1961 * (avg_cpi_1962 / avg_cpi_1961)

print(f"\nDebt FY1960 (nominal): {debt_1960}")
print(f"Debt FY1960 (adjusted to 1962$): {adj_1960}")
print(f"\nDebt FY1961 (nominal): {debt_1961}")
print(f"Debt FY1961 (adjusted to 1962$): {adj_1961}")

# Absolute difference
diff = abs(adj_1961 - adj_1960)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {diff:.3f}")
EOF
